dataPolicy: independent external directories; preserve credentials and conversations
updatePolicy: desktop 0.6.13+ checks npm latest at startup and every six hours; automatically downloads and verifies in a lower-priority worker with two concurrent transfers; ready notification without focus; explicit restart/install; running tool selection unchanged until install; backup before switch
authentication: npm install does not grant model access; existing independent credentials remain local

modelConfiguration.routing: all imported provider/model identities appear in the native model catalogue; an authenticated loopback router selects each provider's endpoint, credentials and protocol
modelConfiguration.credentials: private core/model-access.json; no remote API keys in catalogue, native configuration or CLI results
modelConfiguration.selection: native model picker per chat; models select --model provider/model --yes changes the default while the app is closed
modelConfiguration.compatibility: multi-provider configuration requires both the new npm manager and a desktop containing model routing contract 2

cleanupPolicy.trigger: owned main interface loaded and alive for 30 seconds; installed version and component identity must match
cleanupPolicy.temporaryCacheExcess: pending or unknown receipts pin required blocks; locked files remain available for inspection

windowsAgentShell.preferred: verified system Git Bash; explicit exec_command shell selection
windowsAgentShell.windowsOperations: explicit PowerShell for Registry, COM, services and PowerShell cmdlets
windowsAgentShell.fallback: PowerShell when Git Bash is absent or unusable; report reason
windowsAgentShell.scope: owned bundled CLI stdio app-server thread start, resume and fork; integrated terminal is independent
windowsAgentShell.preservation: preserve caller developer instructions and private tool environment; no configuration writes or command replay
windowsAgentShell.diagnostics: doctor.agentShell: discovered executables, fallback reason and desktopAdapterBundled

distribution.macPolicy: project-local development builds; preserve historical installations and artifacts

desktopUpdater.download: explicit user click; verified chunks cached; current app remains usable
desktopUpdater.install: explicit restart confirmation; copied standalone helper waits for app exit; backup and transactional switch
desktopUpdater.runtime: bundled standalone Node; no global npm upgrade required
desktopUpdater.menu: 更新 → 检查 codex-own 更新…
desktopUpdater.offline: current installation remains usable; manual retry; verified prepared update survives restart

toolRuntime.source: release manifest pinned npm content payloads
toolRuntime.pathPolicy: app and child processes only; user and system PATH preserved
toolRuntime.rollback: verify predecessor and switch receipt; no conversation data restore

releaseBinding.identity: SHA256 of canonical component metadata and raw program/tool assets
releaseBinding.sameDesktop: zero desktop download and activation; app may remain open
releaseBinding.legacy: one bridge desktop upgrade required before ordinary manager-only reuse

installationRecovery.inventory: direct Unicode TAR/PAX/gzip/ZIP inventory; entry types, sizes and SHA256; path/link safety; tar errors retained
installationRecovery.recovery: explicit --yes; refuse live/unknown locks, active apps and incomplete transactions

backgroundUpdate.notification: silent ready notification and menu badge; user click opens update window
backgroundUpdate.installation: user confirmation and graceful app exit
backgroundUpdate.tools: prepare immutable versions without changing active selection
backgroundUpdate.recovery: verified prepared updates survive restart; failed downloads retain verified content blocks
